summary: General Motors Financial Company filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement to register an additional $6.0 billion maximum aggregate of variable-denomination floating-rate demand notes under its existing automatic shelf registration statement (Form S-3, File No. 333-282945, filed November 1, 2024). The fee table calculates a $522,000 registration fee at the statutory rate of $87.00 per $1,000,000. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no price per note, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. Watch only for ongoing funding activity of the captive finance issuer.
